description: This Java class, FineractEntityDataValidator, performs validation and existence checks for entity data within the Fineract framework. It validates JSON payloads for create and update operations, verifies whether referenced entities exist, and handles constraints related to different entity types such as offices, loan products, savings products, charges, and roles.

classes.name: FineractEntityDataValidator
classes.description: A validator component class that provides methods for validating JSON data and ensuring referenced entities exist within the Fineract system, specifically tailored for entity mapping and data integrity checks.

methods.name: validateForCreate
methods.description: Validates incoming JSON payload when creating new entity mappings; checks required fields and date formats, and ensures no unsupported parameters are present.

methods.name: validateForUpdate
methods.description: Validates JSON payload for updating existing entity mappings; ensures at least one field is provided for update and fields conform to expected formats.

methods.name: checkForEntity
methods.description: Verifies the existence of referenced entities based on the relId, including office, loan product, savings product, charges, and roles.

methods.name: checkForOffice
methods.description: Checks if an office entity with the given ID exists.

methods.name: checkForLoanProducts
methods.description: Confirms the existence of a loan product with the specified ID, throws exception if not found.

methods.name: checkForSavingsProducts
methods.description: Confirms the existence of a savings product with the specified ID, throws exception if not found.

methods.name: checkForCharges
methods.description: Checks if a charge entity with the given ID exists.

methods.name: checkForRoles
methods.description: Verifies if a role with the specified ID exists.
